www.honolulu.gov.es: la División de Elecciones de Honolulu (Honolulu Elections Division)

reg_deadline.en: Not registered yet? You can register and vote the same day at a voter service center, open through Election Day. Online registration needs a Hawaii driver's license or state ID. Paper applications closed October 26.
reg_deadline.es: ¿Todavía no estás registrado? Puedes registrarte y votar el mismo día en un centro de servicio al votante (voter service center), abierto hasta el Día de las Elecciones. Para registrarte en línea necesitas una licencia de conducir o identificación estatal de Hawaii. Las solicitudes en papel cerraron el 26 de octubre.
reg_deadline.quote: Online! With your Hawaii Driver License or Hawaii State ID, get registered in a matter of minutes at elections.hawaii.gov. ... VOTER SERVICE CENTERS For same day registration and voting, and accessible voting

mail_request.notes: Every registered voter is mailed a ballot; there is no request deadline. Away from home? The deadline to have the ballot sent to an alternate address is October 27, 2026 (voting page).

mail_return.en: Drop it at a ballot drop box in your county, or mail it in the postage-paid return envelope. Your county must receive it by 7 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3. A postmark isn't enough, so this close to the deadline a drop box is the surer choice.
mail_return.es: Déjala en un buzón de entrega de boletas de tu condado, o envíala por correo en el sobre de devolución con porte pagado. Tu condado debe recibirla a más tardar a las 7 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre. El matasellos no basta, así que a estas alturas un buzón de entrega es lo más seguro.
mail_return.quote: Voted ballots must be received by your County Elections Divisions by 7:00 PM on Election Day to be counted.

early_hours.en: The main voter service centers in each county are open Monday to Saturday, 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., from October 20 to November 2, and 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. on Election Day. Some sites keep shorter schedules. On Oahu, Kaneohe and Wahiawa are open only October 27 to 31, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. In Maui County, Lanai City, Lahaina and Kaunakakai open October 31.
early_hours.es: Los principales centros de servicio al votante de cada condado abren de lunes a sábado, de 8 a. m. a 4:30 p. m., del 20 de octubre al 2 de noviembre, y de 7 a. m. a 7 p. m. el Día de las Elecciones. Algunos lugares tienen horarios más cortos. En Oahu, Kaneohe y Wahiawa abren solo del 27 al 31 de octubre, de 9 a. m. a 5 p. m. En el condado de Maui, Lanai City, Lahaina y Kaunakakai abren el 31 de octubre.
early_hours.quote: General Election October 20, 2026, through November 2, 2026 Monday through Saturday 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. November 3, 2026 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. ... General Election October 31, 2026, through November 2, 2026 Daily except Sunday 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. November 3, 2026 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. County of Maui Old Youth Center 717 Fraser Avenue Lanai City, HI 96763 Lahaina Civic Center 1840 Honoapiilani Highway Lahaina, HI 96761 Mitchell Pau'ole Center Conference Room 90 Ainoa Street Kaunakakai, HI 96748 ... General Election October 27, 2026, through October 31, 2026 Tuesday through Saturday 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. George Fred Wright Wahiawa District Park (Ceramics Room) 1129 Kilani Avenue Wahiawa, HI 96786 Kaneohe District Park (Meeting Room) 45-660 Keaahala Road Kaneohe, HI 96744
early_hours.en_after: The main voter service centers in each county are open Monday to Saturday, 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., through November 2, and 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. on Election Day. In Maui County, Lanai City, Lahaina and Kaunakakai are open November 2 and Election Day.
early_hours.es_after: Los principales centros de servicio al votante de cada condado abren de lunes a sábado, de 8 a. m. a 4:30 p. m., hasta el 2 de noviembre, y de 7 a. m. a 7 p. m. el Día de las Elecciones. En el condado de Maui, Lanai City, Lahaina y Kaunakakai abren el 2 de noviembre y el Día de las Elecciones.

cure.notes: The cure window is relative: five business days after the election (2026 voter guide). It is in mail.cure; no calendar date is computed.

in_person.en: Your ballot comes to you by mail. Rather vote in person? Go to a voter service center in your county, open from October 20 through Election Day (closed Sundays), for in-person voting, accessible voting and same day registration.
in_person.es: Tu boleta te llega por correo. ¿Prefieres votar en persona? Ve a un centro de servicio al votante de tu condado, abierto del 20 de octubre hasta el Día de las Elecciones (cerrado los domingos), para votar en persona, votar con equipo accesible o registrarte el mismo día.
in_person.quote: Open 10 business days prior to the election offering accessible voting, in person voting and same day registration.

first_time.en: Not registered on Election Day? You can still register at a voter service center in your county and vote in person. You'll get a mail ballot for future elections.
first_time.es: ¿No estás registrado el Día de las Elecciones? Todavía puedes registrarte en un centro de servicio al votante de tu condado y votar en persona. Recibirás una boleta por correo para las próximas elecciones.
first_time.quote: You will be permitted to vote in person for that election and will receive a mail ballot for future elections.

locator_label.en: Voter Service Centers and Ballot Drop Boxes (Hawaii Office of Elections)
locator_label.es: Centros de servicio al votante y buzones de entrega (Oficina de Elecciones de Hawaii)

rule.en: Voter service centers and ballot drop boxes are listed by county on the Office of Elections site. Drop your ballot at any drop box in your county.
rule.es: Los centros de servicio al votante y los buzones de entrega de boletas aparecen por condado en el sitio de la Oficina de Elecciones. Deja tu boleta en cualquier buzón de entrega de tu condado.
rule.quote: Drop your voted ballot at a ballot drop box location within your county.

accepted.notes: Mail voters sign the envelope; no ID list for in-person voting was found on elections.hawaii.gov pages read. The existing FAQ answer covers ID.

without.en: Voting in person in Honolulu? Bring an ID. A state driver's license or ID card or a passport works, and so does a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, government document or paycheck with your name and address. No ID? Staff will ask you more questions to confirm who you are, which takes longer.
without.es: ¿Vas a votar en persona en Honolulu? Lleva una identificación. Sirve una licencia de conducir o identificación estatal o un pasaporte, y también un recibo de servicios, estado de cuenta bancario, cheque del gobierno, documento del gobierno o talón de pago reciente con tu nombre y dirección. ¿No tienes? El personal te hará más preguntas para confirmar quién eres, y eso toma más tiempo.
without.quote: To facilitate the voting process, please remember to bring an ID to the Voter Service Center. Acceptable forms of ID include: State issued drivers license; State issued identification card; Valid Passport; or a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, government document, or paycheck bearing your name and current address. ... If you do not have acceptable identification, we will ask you for additional information to confirm your identity. This process will take additional time.

who.en: Every registered voter gets a ballot in the mail, no request needed. Ballots were mailed to arrive by Friday, October 16. Didn't get yours, or made a mistake? Ask your County Elections Division for a replacement.
who.es: Cada votante registrado recibe una boleta por correo, sin tener que pedirla. Las boletas se enviaron para llegar a más tardar el viernes 16 de octubre. ¿No te llegó o te equivocaste? Pide una de reemplazo a la División de Elecciones de tu condado.
who.quote: If you do not receive your ballot, contact your County Elections Division and they will issue you a replacement ballot.

witness.en: Read the statement on your return envelope and sign it. Your ballot can't be counted without your signature. Can't sign on your own? Someone you're comfortable with can help and be your witness, but not your employer, your union agent or a candidate on the ballot.
witness.es: Lee la declaración del sobre de devolución y fírmalo. Tu boleta no se puede contar sin tu firma. ¿No puedes firmar por tu cuenta? Una persona de confianza puede ayudarte y ser tu testigo, pero no tu empleador, un agente de tu sindicato ni un candidato que aparezca en la boleta.
witness.quote: You're permitted to ask someone you feel comfortable with to help read through your ballot, mark your choices, and be your witness if you cannot sign the return envelope independently. Your employer or your union agent is prohibited from helping. ... you are prohibited from receiving assistance from a candidate on the ballot, or your employer or union agent.

cure.en: Your county compares the signature on your envelope with the one on file. If they can't confirm a match, they'll notify you, and you have five business days after Election Day to fix it.
cure.es: Tu condado compara la firma del sobre con la que tiene en tu registro. Si no pueden confirmar que coincide, te avisarán, y tienes cinco días hábiles después del Día de las Elecciones para corregirlo.
cure.quote: If officials are unable to confirm a match, you’ll be notified to fix the issue within five business days post-election.

dropbox.en: Drop it at any ballot drop box in your county by 7 p.m. on Election Day. Locations and hours are on the Office of Elections site.
dropbox.es: Déjala en cualquier buzón de entrega de boletas de tu condado a más tardar a las 7 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones. Los lugares y horarios están en el sitio de la Oficina de Elecciones.
dropbox.quote: Drop your voted ballot at a ballot drop box location within your county.

gear.en: No campaigning within 200 feet of a voter service center or ballot drop box, including its parking lot and walkways. Wearing a campaign shirt or button? Cover it or take it off before you go in.
gear.es: No se permite hacer campaña a menos de 200 pies de un centro de servicio al votante o de un buzón de entrega, incluidos su estacionamiento y sus accesos. ¿Llevas una camiseta o un botón de campaña? Cúbrelo o quítatelo antes de entrar.
gear.quote: a map designating an area of two hundred feet from the perimeter of any voter service center, place of deposit, and its appurtenances. Any person who remains or loiters within this specified area for the purpose of campaigning shall be guilty of a misdemeanor. ... Any voter who displays campaign material in the voter service center, place of deposit, or its appurtenances shall remove or cover that material before entering

phone.en: Hawaii law lets you share a photo of your own marked ballot, on social media or anywhere else. It doesn't cover taking photos inside a voter service center, so ask staff first and keep other voters and their ballots out of the frame.
phone.es: La ley de Hawaii te permite compartir una foto de tu propia boleta marcada, en redes sociales o en cualquier otro lugar. No dice nada sobre tomar fotos dentro de un centro de servicio al votante, así que pregunta primero al personal y no saques a otros votantes ni sus boletas en la foto.
phone.quote: A voter shall not be prohibited from distributing or sharing an electronic or digital image of the voter's own marked ballot via social media or other means regardless of how the voter acquired the image; provided that this section shall not be a defense for any election offenses under chapter 19 or related offenses under the Penal Code.

line.en: Voting closes at 7 p.m. on Election Day. If you're in line at a voter service center or a ballot drop box by then, stay in line. You'll be allowed to vote or drop off your ballot. Leave the line and you can't rejoin.
line.es: La votación cierra a las 7 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones. Si a esa hora estás en la fila de un centro de servicio al votante o de un buzón de entrega, no te salgas. Te dejarán votar o entregar tu boleta. Si te sales de la fila, no puedes volver a entrar.
line.quote: Officials mark the end of the line, and you will not be permitted to rejoin if you leave.

tradition.en: Hawaii tied its sticker to ballot tracking. In 2022, once your ballot was accepted for counting, you could download a virtual "I Voted" sticker.
tradition.es: Hawaii unió su sticker al seguimiento de boletas. En 2022, cuando aceptaban tu boleta para contarla, podías descargar un sticker virtual de "I Voted".
tradition.quote: “Once your ballot has been accepted for counting, voters can also download their virtual ‘I Voted’ sticker,” he added.

provisional.en: You can ask for a provisional ballot if your voter registration can't be confirmed. It's counted only if your County Elections Division confirms your registration. You can find out whether it counted by calling them or on the Office of Elections website.
provisional.es: Puedes pedir una boleta provisional si no se puede confirmar tu registro de votante. Solo se cuenta si la División de Elecciones de tu condado confirma tu registro. Puedes saber si se contó llamando a esa oficina o en el sitio web de la Oficina de Elecciones.
provisional.quote: You can request a provisional ballot if you cannot confirm your voter registration.

line.en: Stay in line. If you're in line at 7 p.m. at a voter service center or a drop box, you'll be allowed to vote or drop off your ballot.
line.es: No te salgas de la fila. Si estás en la fila a las 7 p. m. en un centro de servicio al votante o un buzón de entrega, te dejarán votar o entregar tu boleta.
line.quote: If you are in line, stay in line.

track.en: Sign up for ballot tracking alerts by text, email or voice call at elections.hawaii.gov. You'll hear when your ballot is mailed, when it's received and accepted, and when the deadline is close.
track.es: Regístrate en elections.hawaii.gov para recibir avisos de seguimiento de tu boleta por mensaje de texto, correo electrónico o llamada. Te avisarán cuando envíen tu boleta, cuando la reciban y la acepten, y cuando se acerque la fecha límite.
track.quote: Sign up for ballot tracking alerts via text, email, or voice call at elections.hawaii.gov.

unsigned.en: Your ballot can't be counted without your signature. If officials can't confirm your signature, they'll notify you, and you have five business days after Election Day to fix it.
unsigned.es: Tu boleta no se puede contar sin tu firma. Si no pueden confirmar tu firma, te avisarán, y tienes cinco días hábiles después del Día de las Elecciones para corregirlo.
unsigned.quote: If officials are unable to confirm a match, you’ll be notified to fix the issue within five business days post-election.

late_mail.en: It counts only if your county receives it by 7 p.m. on November 3. A postmark isn't enough. This close to the deadline, use a ballot drop box in your county instead of the mail.
late_mail.es: Solo cuenta si tu condado la recibe a más tardar a las 7 p. m. del 3 de noviembre. El matasellos no basta. A estas alturas, usa un buzón de entrega de tu condado en lugar del correo.
late_mail.quote: Voted ballots must be received by your County Elections Divisions by 7:00 PM on Election Day to be counted.

notes: Read October 21, 2026 on elections.hawaii.gov (curl worked): Voting, Voter Service Centers and Ballot Drop Boxes, Voting in Hawaii, Provisional Voting, Replacement Ballot, County Elections Divisions, the October 16 ballot news release, the 2022 ballot tracking release, and the 2026 General Election Voter Guide PDF. states.js treats Hawaii as all-mail (ballots by October 16, received by 7 p.m. November 3); both match. Voter service centers run October 20 to November 3, excluding Sundays (voting page); smaller sites (Lanai, Molokai, Hana, Wahiawa, Kaneohe) have shorter schedules. capitol.hawaii.gov (HRS) returned a Cloudflare 403 to curl and a bot check in Chrome, so the electioneering distance (HRS 11-132) was not read. No tracking URL is set: the sign-up link is not on the pages read (BallotTrax is named on Voting in Hawaii). The October 27 alternate-address deadline is on the voting page. Sticker: the virtual sticker is from a 2022 release; no 2026 page confirms it. Oct 28 pass: HRS read on data.capitol.hawaii.gov (the capitol.hawaii.gov mirror; www host still blocks): 11-121 ballot images, 11-132 200-foot zone, 11-106 cure (five business days, which computes to Tuesday, November 10, 2026; no official page found stating that date, so not on the page). Honolulu Elections Division voter service center page read for ID. Voter service center schedules re-read on elections.hawaii.gov.
